named-query.name: Bills.getAllBillDTOByClinicId
named-query.query: SELECT NEW example.medCashFlow.dto.bill.BillResponseDTO( b.id, i.id, i.isPaid, b.name, b.pricing, CAST(b.type AS string), b.employee.id, b.involved.id, b.accountPlanning.id, b.paymentMethod.name, i.dueDate ) FROM bills b JOIN b.installments i WHERE b.clinic.id = :clinicId
